targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT run_id FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE stage LIKE 'live_soak_%' OR stage LIKE 't4%' GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY max(metric_ts) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT COALESCE(max(metric_value), 0) AS value FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM latest) AND metric_name IN ('gate_status_pass','gate_status_warning','gate_status_block');

WITH latest AS (SELECT run_id FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE stage LIKE 'live_soak_%' OR stage LIKE 't4%' GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY max(metric_ts) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT COALESCE(max(metric_value), 0) AS lag_after FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM latest) AND metric_name IN ('consumer_lag_after','lag_after');

WITH latest AS (SELECT run_id FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE stage LIKE 'live_soak_%' OR stage LIKE 't4%' GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY max(metric_ts) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT COALESCE(max(metric_value), 0) AS retry FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM latest) AND metric_name='consumer_retry';

WITH latest AS (SELECT run_id FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE stage LIKE 'live_soak_%' OR stage LIKE 't4%' GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY max(metric_ts) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT COALESCE(max(metric_value), 0) AS dlq FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM latest) AND metric_name='consumer_dlq';

WITH recent AS (SELECT run_id, max(metric_ts) AS latest_ts FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE stage LIKE 'live_soak_%' OR stage LIKE 't4%' GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY latest_ts DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT r.latest_ts, m.run_id, max(m.stage) AS stage, max(m.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE m.metric_name IN ('producer_accepted','producer_emitted')) AS producer_events, max(m.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE m.metric_name='consumer_processed') AS processed, max(m.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE m.metric_name='consumer_inserted') AS inserted, max(m.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE m.metric_name='consumer_duplicate') AS duplicate, max(m.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE m.metric_name='consumer_retry') AS retry, max(m.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE m.metric_name='consumer_dlq') AS dlq, max(m.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE m.metric_name IN ('consumer_lag_after','lag_after')) AS lag_after FROM recent r JOIN ops.pipeline_metric m USING (run_id) GROUP BY r.latest_ts, m.run_id ORDER BY r.latest_ts DESC;

panels.title: Processed / inserted / duplicate / retry / DLQ invariant

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT run_id FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE stage LIKE 'live_soak_%' OR stage LIKE 't4%' GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY max(metric_ts) DESC LIMIT 1), pivot AS (SELECT metric_name, max(metric_value) AS value FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM latest) GROUP BY metric_name) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_processed'),0) AS processed, COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_inserted'),0) AS inserted, COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_duplicate'),0) AS duplicate, COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_retry'),0) AS retry, COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_dlq'),0) AS dlq, COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name IN ('consumer_lag_after','lag_after')),0) AS lag_after, COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_processed'),0) - COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_inserted'),0) - COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_duplicate'),0) - COALESCE((SELECT value FROM pivot WHERE metric_name='consumer_dlq'),0) AS invariant_delta;
SELECT metric_ts, run_id, stage, metric_name, metric_value, unit, labels FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE stage LIKE 'live_soak_%' OR stage LIKE 't4%' ORDER BY metric_ts DESC LIMIT 200;
